analyst.summary: Max Healthcare keeps delivering - revenue and profit have grown every quarter for more than five years running, its newest hospitals (Lucknow, Nagpur, Noida, Bhubaneswar) are being funded from a healthy balance sheet, and international patients plus its diagnostics (Max Lab) and home-healthcare (Max@Home) arms are growing fast. But the share price already assumes all of that goes right for many years to come - at roughly 74 times last year's profit and about 10 times book value, it is one of the most expensive hospital stocks in the country, and recent quarters show per-bed revenue growth has actually slowed to low single digits. We rate MAXHEALTH Sell: a well-run hospital business, priced well ahead of what we think it can realistically deliver over the next few years.
